name: jev-dispatch
description: Routes delegated subtasks to cheap/normal/frontier workers via Jev capability tiers, with verification, escalation and local experiment telemetry.

jev_provider.title: Jev provider
jev_provider.description: Where to reach Jev. TypeSafe is the direct API; the others are gateways. Leave as typesafe if unsure. Not needed for the fixed-tier baseline arms.

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key
jev_api_key.description: The key for the provider above. Stored in your keychain, never in settings.json or the plugin's config file. Leave empty to run the fixed-tier baselines, which make no routing calls.

jev_account_id.title: Account ID (Cloudflare only)
jev_account_id.description: Your Cloudflare account ID. Only needed for the cloudflare provider; leave empty otherwise.

jev_endpoint.title: Custom endpoint
jev_endpoint.description: Overrides the provider's default URL. Required for the passthrough and custom providers, e.g. a LiteLLM proxy; leave empty otherwise.
